48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 5 days → total added = 341 days.  
1092 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not century exception because 1092 < 1582).  
From 04-24: days remaining in April = 6, May = 31, June = 30, July = 31, August = 31, September = 30, October = 31, November = 30, December = 31.  
Sum to end of year: 6 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 241 days.  
341 − 241 = 100 days into 1093.  
1093 not leap (not divisible by 4). Jan 31, Feb 28 → 31 + 28 = 59, remaining 41 days into March → March 31 + 10 days → April 10.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1093-04-10
